critical_code_review_comments: EXCELLENT: ownership guard is now centralised in `services/auth.py::require_retailer_ownership_async` and applied consistently across sales.py, retailer_os.py, retailer_inventory.py and inventory.py. Foot-gun from iter_32 is eliminated.

Solid auto-scoping in /api/inventory: retailer / distributor / wholesaler callers default to their own scope; super_admin is forced to be explicit (400 if not). This prevents accidental cross-tenant queries.

Minor: the ownership guard is invoked inside the route function body (not as a FastAPI dependency), so Pydantic body validation can still 422 before the 403 fires. Move to Depends() pattern for cleaner contract.
Recommend adding an integration test in CI specifically named `test_p0_ownership_fix.py` (now done) so any future regression on this guard is caught immediately.

rca_of_the_issue.original_finding_iter_32: Cross-tenant leak on /api/retailer/{rid}/sales, /dashboard, /sales-trend, /reorder-suggestions and /api/inventory?owner_type=retailer&owner_id=<any>. Routes scoped MongoDB queries by URL path param without verifying caller ownership.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: New helper `require_retailer_ownership_async(user, retailer_id)` in /app/backend/services/auth.py — permits: (a) super_admin, (b) retailer.entity_id == retailer_id, (c) manufacturer/distributor in the upstream tree (via async DB ancestry walk). Applied to every /api/retailer/{rid}/* read+write route in routes/sales.py, retailer_os.py, retailer_inventory.py, and to routes/inventory.py when owner_type='retailer'. /api/inventory also auto-scopes for retailer/distributor/wholesaler callers when no params given, and requires explicit params for super_admin (400 otherwise).
